title: Heated Confrontation Ends Horrifically
description:
25-year-old Suesue was out celebrating his birthday with friends when things took a tragic turn after an argument with a stranger at the bar. Moments later, emergency services were called to the scene for a reported incident involving serious violence. The victim, 30-year-old Belford, did not survive despite medical efforts. While Suesue claimed it was self-defense and some witnesses supported his version, CCTV footage later revealed he may have acted first. One key witness eventually came forward, and authorities pieced together the events. Belford’s passing was ruled a ho*icide, and Suesue was charged accordingly.
